about: Excalidraw's faces, copied out of node_modules into public/ by scripts/vendor-assets.mjs before every build, so this server serves them itself (lib/board/excalidrawAssets.ts) and no board asks esm.sh, Excalidraw's own default. The folder is named by the start of the faces' tree sha256, so new faces get a new folder; excalidrawAssets.test.ts holds the version to the installed package. The tree's sha256 covers every file's path and sha256 (vendor-assets.mjs treeHash): a package that changed under the same version fails the build.

packages.licence: MIT (package.json); each face under its own licence, as its file's name table says: public/board/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, written by scripts/board-notices.mjs

Cascadia.from: the OFL release on GitHub, unchanged: microsoft/cascadia-code v2005.15, CascadiaCode_2005.15.zip (sha256 b3d8495e9cdee90d0dbaf60b7db018413e130265dc27e2be7a8db04cf98fddce), woff2/CascadiaCode.woff2

Excalifont.statedBy: Excalidraw's own source, packages/excalidraw/fonts/Excalifont/index.ts (the face's metadata), since the font file names no licence

Liberation.licence: GNU General Public License v2 with the Liberation font exception (Red Hat's Liberation 1.x licence agreement)

Xiaolai.statedBy: Excalidraw's own source, packages/excalidraw/fonts/Xiaolai/index.ts (the face's metadata), since the font file names no licence
